title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B (nemotron_h_moe): tokenizer, 88-layer tensor-binding plan, model-backed streamed layer execution
author: LLM Bridge
scope: Model-backed execution of the real GGUF weights via bounded authenticated streaming: the full 88-layer tensor-binding plan, one genuine layer of each type through the streamed reader, a full 88-layer forward on a raw token, and a GGUF byte-level BPE tokenizer. NOT a reference-parity check of the full model and NOT the 'capital of France' first token (see status).

commits_this_round.summary: feat(model): real 88-layer tensor-binding plan + model-backed streamed layers
feat(model): streamed full 88-layer forward executor + greedy token
feat(tokenizer): GGUF byte-level BPE loader, decoder, and BPE core

tokenizer.loaded_from: shard-1 GGUF header (self-contained bounded KV reader)
verified: GPT-2 byte<->unicode map is a bijection over 256 bytes
decode skips control/unknown/unused tokens by token_type
decode(encode(x)) == x on ASCII incl. 'The capital of France is'
tokenizer.parity_status: PARTIAL / honest: loader + decoder exact and verified; BPE merge engine uses the real merge ranks; the pixtral pre-tokenizer is approximated by a documented GPT-2-style splitter (no regex engine available, no runnable llama.cpp reference). Token IDs are NOT claimed byte-identical to the reference for arbitrary text. ACCEPTANCE A: not fully met (reference cross-check impossible in this environment).

model_plan.built_from: SplitGgufIndex over the 3 real shards (tensor table only; no weight payload)
model_plan.validation: every required tensor resolved and shape-checked per layer; rejects missing/incompatible tensors before any execution

model_backed_layer_execution.mechanism: all projections via dequant_matvec (one row streamed at a time); packed experts via PackedExperts (only the 22 selected read); small per-layer F32 params decoded directly; the F32 router via a dense dot. F32/F16/BF16 are decoded directly because ggml has no to_float dequantizer for float formats.
model_backed_layer_execution.acceptance_B: MET — one genuine layer of each required type executes through the streamed reader on the real model

ran.embedding: token 42 via a single bounded row read (Q4_K) -> finite n_embd vector
ran.mamba_layer_0: Q6_K ssm_in/out streamed + F32 conv/A/D/norm + conv/scan math -> finite n_embd
ran.attention_layer_7: Q5_K Q/K/V/O streamed + GQA 32:2 causal attention -> finite n_embd
ran.moe_layer_1: F32 router + Q8_0 latent + Q5_K/Q6_K shared expert + IQ2_XXS up / IQ4_NL down experts (22/512 selected) -> finite n_embd

model_backed_layer_execution.memory: bounded streaming; no full tensor materialized; model never resident

full_88_layer_forward.note: produces genuine finite logits over the 131072 vocabulary and a greedy token id (1044) via bounded streaming; the model is never resident. This is a raw single-token (<s>) forward, NOT the 'capital of France' prompt, so the token is not claimed to be a meaningful continuation. NOT validated against a full-model resident reference (none runnable on this host).
